sources.title: gemma 4 31B it — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B Instruct is a 30.7B parameter dense multimodal model from Google DeepMind supporting text and image inputs with text output. It features a 262,144 token context window, native function calling, configurable reasoning mode, and multilingual support across 140+ languages. The model is positioned for coding, reasoning, and document understanding tasks.

sources.title: Gemma 4 - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of generative artificial intelligence models and you can use them in a wide variety of generation tasks, including question answering, summarization, and reasoning. Gemma models are provided with open weights and permit responsible commercial use, allowing you to tune and deploy them in your own projects and applications.
